summary: AI reviewerには実装Agentと異なる証拠源(実行結果・別context・別model・仕様書)を与え、findingは検証(disprove)stepと重大度付けを経てadvisoryにし、blockingは狭い高impact条件に限定する

evidence.summary: Anthropic Code Review: 並列agentがbugを探し「verify bugs to filter out false positives, and rank bugs by severity」。社内で「less than 1% of findings are marked incorrect」(vendor自己報告)。
GitHub Copilot code review: Low/Medium analysis tierをorg/repo単位で設定、Medium tier attributionをPRに表示。
Copilot code review: custom instructions文字数制限撤廃、content exclusionでreview対象pathを制御。
GitHub: 「Let Copilot review it first」で機械的問題を先に除き、人間は判断が要る箇所へ集中。
Fable 5: fresh-context verifier subagentが自己批評より優れる。Code review/debugのbug-finding recallが向上(recallの向上はfalse positive制御と別に管理が必要)。
機械検査を人間の前に置くが最終判断にしない(operationally-supported)。

code-review (public, reputation established): read SKILL.md: step 4 spawns the Standards and Spec sub-agents with separate briefs and separate evidence (repo standards plus a smell baseline; the originating spec text), and step 5 forbids merging or reranking the two reports, so no single blocking verdict is produced and findings stay advisory.

applies_when: AI reviewer(Claude Code code-review plugin, Copilot code review等)をPRに使う
reviewerが独立にテスト/型/buildを実行できる
not_applicable_when: reviewerが実装Agentと同一session/同一contextしか持たない場合は独立性が成立しない
applicability.model_conditions: model-dependent (false positive率・recallはmodel/tierで変動; W3)

expected_effect.primary: 同一前提の誤りをすり抜けさせず、過剰修正・false positiveによるreview飽和を抑える
metrics: blocking指摘のうち人間が却下した比率
reviewerが独立実行した検証(test/build)の有無

risks: vendor報告のfalse positive率は自社codebase前提
AI reviewを人間判断の完全代替にすると同じoracle問題を再生産
known_failure_modes: AI reviewを最終判断にする(local card)
実装と同じcontext/prompt/前提をreviewerに渡す(F11)
revalidate_when: false positive率の局所測定結果

existing_asset.confirmed_by: read SKILL.md: step 4 spawns the Standards and Spec sub-agents with separate briefs and separate evidence (repo standards plus a smell baseline; the originating spec text), and step 5 forbids merging or reranking the two reports, so no single blocking verdict is produced and findings stay advisory.
matched_on: Standards and Spec reviews run as parallel sub-agents specifically so they do not pollute each other's context
the Spec sub-agent is given the originating issue/spec — evidence independent of the implementer's context — and must quote the spec line for each finding
findings are labelled hard violation vs judgement call and reported per axis without merging, i.e. advisory rather than blocking
existing_asset.verified_by: existing-skill research 2026-08-15 (ai-development-improvement 0.7.1 lookup + reputation pass, Opus workers)

alternates.why_not_primary: Established; implements the disprove step directly — each suspected finding is restated, traced and driven to a TRUE/FALSE POSITIVE verdict, with an explicit rule that LLMs are biased toward seeing bugs and overrating severity — but it is scoped to security findings and verifies one claim at a time.

evidence: listed at plugins/fp-check/skills/fp-check/SKILL.md in the repo tree at HEAD

alternates.why_not_primary: Opened in this pass and established (Anthropic, 7,051 stars): it verifies each finding is real using N verifier votes (default 3), deduplicates, re-ranks by derived exploitability rather than the scanner's claimed severity, and routes to an owner — the remedy's disprove-plus-severity step. Not primary because it triages a batch of scanner output rather than configuring the reviewer's evidence sources.

evidence: read .claude/skills/triage/SKILL.md at HEAD (verify / deduplicate / rank by derived exploitability / route to owner; --votes N verifier votes, default 3)
